pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted Nd2-f1-g3 with a rook on f1; plan 1 relied on an unsupported g4-g5 attack; plan 4 used the g7-bishop through the f6-knight. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling.

pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the b1-knight via d2-f1 (no knight on b1, rook on f1); plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight already on c7. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: 2. Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a rook lift Rh1-h3-g3 with the h2-pawn in the way and targeted pawns not yet advanced; plan 2 used an advanced g-pawn that is still on g7. Rewrote both plans around ...g5 Bg3 and ...f4.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Hopton Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2 exchanged on f6 with no knight there; plan 3 pushed ...g5 onto the bishop. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling (Defence, neutralise, less-travelled).

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Raphael Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 read White's e4 push as a Black move. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Spielmann Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 brought the queen to h5 through the e2-pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Bg5 c6
pages.notes: Plan 1 exchanged on f6 with no knight there and claimed it weakens Black's dark squares (reviewer: White gives up its own dark-squared bishop); plan 2 pushed ...g5 onto the bishop. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Bg5 d5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 exchanged on f6 with no knight there; plan 2 relied on a g-file only open after Bxf6 gxf6. Rewrote overview sentence and plans 1-2.
